Only when the widespread investigative reports were published across mainstream national dailies, || C. Many a prominent economist and seasoned financial market analyst, || Column 2: D. it has simultaneously saddled the developing economy with an unprecedented sovereign debt. || E. the regulatory authorities did take any concrete and punitive action against the bank fraud. || F. have strongly condemned the central bank's overly hawkish stance on interest rates. || Question: Which combination is correct?
explanation: Sirf A-D 'Although' ka use karke ek badhiya contrast banata hai (recession roka par debt badha diya). B-E galat hai kyunki 'Only when' se start hone wale sentences ke main clause (second part) mein Inversion lagna zaroori hai. Sahi sentence hoga: '...did the regulatory authorities take any...'. C-F galat hai kyunki 'Many a' ke baad aane wala Noun aur Verb HAMESHA singular hote hain. Isliye 'have' ki jagah 'has' hona chahiye.
trick: Only when, Only after, Only then - in sabse shuru hone wale paragraph me dusra hissa (main clause) me 'Helping verb + Subject' ka order check karein.
tip: 'Sovereign debt' ka matlab desh ki sarkar par chadha hua karz.

question: Direction: Two columns are given containing incomplete sentences. Match Column 1 with Column 2 to form grammatically correct and coherent sentences. || Column 1: A. Such was the sheer ferocity and unpredictability of the massive cyclonic storm, || B. Despite the vehement opposition from several leading indigenous environmental activists, || C. The primary reason why the ambitious merger and acquisition deal ultimately fell through, || Column 2: D. that it completely decimated the coastal fishing hamlets within a matter of hours. || E. the controversial coal mining project was eventually given the green light by the ministry. || F. was due to the fundamentally irreconcilable cultural differences between the two entities. || Question: Which combination is correct?
explanation: A-D mein 'Such... that' ka intensive structure ekdum logically ek natural disaster ka impact bata raha hai. B-E mein 'Despite' ka sahi virodhabhasi (contrast) use hua hai (virodh ke bawajood approval mil gaya). C-F mein Superfluous error hai: 'The reason why' ya 'The reason' ke sath sentence mein kabhi bhi aage chal kar 'due to' ya 'because' nahi aata, wahan sirf 'that' lagta hai.
trick: The reason why... because/due to = ERROR. Exam me is phrase ko dekh kar extra reasoning words ko turant reject karein.
tip: 'Ferocity' ka matlab bhayankarta ya krodh (fierceness) hota hai.

question: Direction: Two columns are given containing incomplete sentences. Match Column 1 with Column 2 to form grammatically correct and coherent sentences. || Column 1: A. Barely the fragile ceasefire agreement had been formally signed by the diplomats, || B. Whether the struggling telecommunications firm manages to successfully secure fresh funding, || C. As long as the deeply entrenched bureaucratic inertia continues to stifle innovation, || Column 2: D. then heavy artillery shelling tragically resumed along the highly disputed border. || E. or painfully files for bankruptcy will dictate the telecom market dynamics tomorrow. || F. foreign direct investment will remain woefully inadequate for ambitious national projects. || Question: Which combination is correct?
explanation: B-E mein 'Whether... or' ka use perfectly alternative possibilities (funding milegi ya bankcruptcy hogi) dikhane ke liye kiya gaya hai. C-F ek proper conditional sentence hai ('As long as' + present condition -> future result). A-D poori tarah galat hai: pehli baat 'Barely' sentence ke shuru mein hone par Inversion chahiye (Barely had the agreement...), dusri baat 'Barely' ke sath 'then' nahi, 'when' lagta hai.
trick: 'Barely' ke do basic rules hain: 1) Inversion (Helping verb pehle), 2) Conjunction pair 'when' aayega. Dono check karna zaroori hai.
tip: 'Entrenched' matlab puri tarah se jama hua jise badalna mushkil ho.

question: Direction: Two columns are given containing incomplete sentences. Match Column 1 with Column 2 to form grammatically correct and coherent sentences. || Column 1: A. In spite of the severe logistical constraints gracefully posed by the ongoing global pandemic, || B. Not only did the excessive reliance on traditional fossil fuels degrade the environment, || C. Either the developed nations fulfill their long-pending climate finance commitments, || Column 2: D. the e-commerce giant astonishingly managed to deliver essential goods seamlessly across the nation. || E. but it also jeopardizes the long-term strategic energy security of the entire nation. || F. nor the developing world will bear the severe brunt of ongoing ecological disasters. || Question: Which combination is correct?
explanation: A-D 'In spite of' (ke bawajood) ka bilkul sahi istemal karke contrast dikha raha hai (constraints ke bawajood seamless delivery). B-E 'Not only... but also' ka correct use dikha raha hai jismein shuruwat me Inversion (did) bhi apply kiya gaya hai. C-F galat hai kyunki 'Either' ka proper joda hamesha 'or' hota hai, jabki sentence mein examiner ne 'nor' use kiya hai jo ki invalid hai.
trick: Ek baar fir se sabse common grammatical trap: Either-or, Neither-nor ki pairing. Options me Either dikhe toh turant aage Nor dhund kar eliminate karein.
tip: 'Jeopardizes' ka matlab kisi cheez ko khatre mein daalna (endanger).
